acceptance: Accepted by the Product Owner at 77601405 on 2026-10-05, after eight rounds of delivery with live PRE-LIVE verification reported at each round.
scope_closed: One unified Client Network creation workflow: untagged or many tagged VLANs on one trunk, each with its own subnet, gateway and DHCP scope, created all-or-nothing, with conflicts refused where they are entered.

A topology change that is genuinely staged: staging writes nothing to public.guest_networks, the enabled-state transition happens only inside the apply transaction, and a rollback restores the previous configuration completely, including rebuilding a removed bridge and its addressing.

A replaced client network keeps its logical identity (appliance migration 0106), so an unused printed voucher pinned to an immutable revision naming the retired network still redeems on its successor.
SITE_NETWORK eligibility decides for PMS room sign-in, which had evaluated it with an empty client-network id.

The forward republish preserves the current package revision exactly, and a package that cannot be carried forward refuses the confirm rather than leaving the wire permanent and the catalogue behind it.

Database, confirmed revision and live Linux network cannot knowingly disagree: the confirm/watchdog race, the expired recovery context, superseded-read-as-failed, two kernel commands that could not fail, and a boot reconcile that asserted half its intent are closed.

POST /network/adopt and netd POST /v1/adopt are retired; MarkActive requires pending_confirmation unconditionally, so an active revision is by construction one the appliance applied and health-checked.

Source-device identification is reliable and consistent across every guest path: a cold neighbour cache no longer refuses a legitimate client, every server-reached refusal leaves operator-visible evidence, and a transport failure no longer masquerades as bad guest credentials.
Client Accounts: a real session disconnect, the generated account password format (migration 0104), and the removal of a lockout counter nothing ever set. Nine growing lists are server-paged.
The stale service-plan notice directs operators to the repin workflow that exists instead of one that cannot work.
